facts.fact: 他看她恐慌却忍住：吞她的渴望只需一念头——但他不能也不愿；veil 日渐变薄。
facts.anchor: To feed on the longing that radiates from her like heat would require the smallest effort.

facts.fact: 第一世：笑声如庙钟、会织布作画塑陶——「那是在认识我之前」；每轮生死她的光更暗。
facts.anchor: She was not always like this

facts.fact: 神格自报：以凡人未遂欲望为食（丧子母亲/被夺所爱恋人/窥见完美的艺术家）——唯独 Never Maven's。
facts.anchor: I am Aakanksh, God of Longing.

facts.fact: 最大揭示：每次自杀尝试他都在前一刻取走她的绝望——她以为的「缺勇气」是善意篡改；「I let her believe this. It is kinder than the truth.」
facts.anchor: Each time she has tried to end this life

facts.fact: 神界设定：战后六位黑暗神各获许配灵魂；「事故」让灵魂投进凡胎——须自由意志选择回家；Vorin 已先收回他的。
facts.anchor: The Bright Gods offered a soul to each of the six Dark Gods after the Great War

facts.fact: 白纱=保护性显形：真容会烧毁凡人神智；他看得见她每根睫毛——她只看见白丝（The Nameless God 则以旋涡黑暗示人）。
facts.anchor: Maven sees me draped in white silk that obscures my features, though I feel nothing on my face.

facts.fact: 本世=「最暗的一版」Maven Talmay（27 岁/八年九城/寄养幸存者）——灵魂被流放磨到忘记认出快乐。
facts.anchor: This Maven—Maven Talmay, twenty-seven years old

facts.fact: 她没叫他走、没否认他；两人呼吸同步——本世第一次「希望展开」：「This time will be different」；今夜只给 presence without demand。
facts.anchor: For the first time in this mortal lifetime, hope unfurls in me.
